featured_reviews.name: Suyash Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I found Vasai Virar Painting while searching on Google and after reading all the positive reviews, I decided to give them a try. Glad I did.
We hired Mr. Somnath for complete wall painting of our house and some masonry work in the kitchen. He first did a proper inspection and explained everything clearly. I liked how he gave his own suggestions and inputs - it actually helped us make better decisions instead of just blindly choosing things.
The team was professional and finished the work neatly. Pricing is reasonable, and the final result is really good, honestly better than what we expected.
Overall, very happy with their service. Would definitely recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Prayag Augustine
featured_reviews.review_text: I engaged Mr Somnath for painting, washroom renovation and repair work at my flat after reading all the fabulous reviews. And iam glad i didn't look any further. He and his team especially Ram bhai are super professional and takes lot of effort to ensure the work done is of the highest quality. Mr Somnath provides lot of attention to detail and recommended many suggestions during the course of the work that left me with a flat looking as good as new! And that too in the agreed timelines. I would highly recommend Vasai Virar Painting for all your repair and painting needs.

featured_reviews.name: Okay
featured_reviews.review_text: Brilliant service and very helpful people. Somnath Ji and Ram Ji put great efforts and made my home new again. Good people to work with.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent work carried out.

Nature of Mr. Somnath Das Ji and his team were very hard working, professional, humble, dedicated and attention to detail which we liked the most.

Work was completed as assured within the time frame.

Will always recommend to go for Vasai and Virar Painting, owner Mr. Somnath Das Ji.

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Lohote
featured_reviews.review_text:
The best part is Quality of work. Somnath ji is very understanding and customer satisfaction focused. Their team is very professional and helpful especially painter ram bhai.

I had salty wall due to which the wall colour was torn out and cement was visible in hall and bedroom.

Somnath ji advised for treatment of waterproofing which is actually applied to outerside of building that has more shell life. We proceeded ahead and went for the best quality.

Overall very satisfied with the work. Thank you Somanth ji and your painting team.

Go for it guys if anyone is looking for quality work. We went for white theme this time since we were bored of dark and yellow theme.

featured_reviews.name: Aniruddha Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got my Honda City fully restored and repainted at Auto Epics by Mr. Vinay and his team, and I am genuinely very happy with the final outcome.

The team did a fabulous job with the complete restoration, paintwork, alloy wheel finish, and overall detailing of the car. The cherry red metallic paint finish came out extremely premium with excellent gloss and smoothness. The attention to detail in the bodywork and finishing is clearly visible.

What I liked most:
✔ Professional guidance throughout the project
✔ Good paint quality and finish
✔ Proper panel alignment and detailing
✔ Timely updates during the work
✔ Friendly and cooperative staff

The car now has amazing road presence and looks much newer than before. Big thanks to Mr. Vinay and the entire team for bringing my vision to life.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for car restoration, repainting, detailing, or customization work in Vasai

featured_reviews.name: Satyajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got PPF done on my new Himalayan 450 at Auto Epics Detailing Studio, and I’m extremely happy with their work. The finish and detailing were top-notch, and they handled my bike with great care and professionalism.
After about 5 months, I noticed a few scratches on the bike due to some unforeseen reasons. When I took it back to them, they carefully inspected everything and repaired it properly without any hassle. Their team was very understanding, supportive, and made sure the quality of service remained excellent.
It’s rare to find a studio that stands by their work even months later. Highly recommended for anyone looking for PPF or detailing services in Vasai! 👍

featured_reviews.name: Saranya Suresh
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently got PPF done for my Seltos 2026 GTX and had a great experience overall. The work was clean, neat, and done with great attention to detail. What really stood out was the phenomenal follow-up after the work was completed. Vinay guided us throughout the process, patiently explained everything, and ensured we were comfortable at every step. Highly professional service and definitely recommended!

featured_reviews.name: rahul nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had been looking for a PPF for my xuv700 ax7 for over a month when I stumbled upon Auto Epics car detailing near western inn and captain drunk restaurant. The price band and warranty tenure is econimally well set and will highly recommend to go for their services if one is looking for a PPF in or near Vasai area.

Vinay is very humble in explaining the details of the service offering and what material is used. Roughly it takes 3 to 4 days for PPF. The staff is well equipped with necessary tools and are skilled. Post agreement of terms and advance payment timely details of activities carried out throughout the day is updated on WhatsApp.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for appreciating our work 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Mansoor Raj
featured_reviews.review_text: I went to Auto Epics for my car Polish and the work done was amazing. Also had the chance to talk to Vinay, the owner, amazing guy, was really helpful and explained in detail the process and how to take care of car's paint. Was really satisfied with the result.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Mansoor Sir for appreciating the work we have done on your Car.

featured_reviews.name: Parth Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve installed PPF on the tank  and side panels of my Royal Enfield GT 650.
From my experience, this setup is safe for the bike and makes sense if you want protection without overdoing it.
What I Noticed
•	The tank is well protected from scratches caused by riding gear, zippers and daily use.
•	The bumper and sides now feel safer from small stone chips and road debris.
•	The original paint is intact underneath, and there’s no permanent damage to the bike.
I would suggest Autoepics  for ppf in vasai
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for appreciating our work. Means a lot to us 🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Melwin Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: Good evening everyone. I have been getting the awesome services for all my cars from Auto Epics Detailing Studio. The end outcome is amazing. I really appreciate the valuable efforts take in minute details by the entire team for the outstanding results. Wishing well for the future to come.

Thank you Sir for appreciating our work.
Means a lot coming from someone who understands the amount of efforts that go in delivery the quality of work that we wish to provide.
We will make sure you always have the same or better results in our work in the future.
Thanks a lot 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Bhupendra Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent work! I had a scratch and dent on my Tata Nexon, and he removed it perfectly. The car looks completely new again. Really impressed with the quality of work. Highly recommended!
